subject: Hospitality
title: Smart Rooms and IoT
description: A micro-lesson that makes Smart Rooms and IoT usable.

hook.text: Smart hotel rooms adjust lighting, temperature, and curtains automatically based on guest preferences.

buildup.text: IoT sensors detect when guests enter, sleep, or leave. The room adapts without anyone touching a switch.

discovery.text: Wynn Las Vegas put Amazon Echo in every room. Guests control everything by voice—lights, TV, even drapes.

twist.text: Privacy concerns are real. Always-listening devices in bedrooms make many guests deeply uncomfortable.

climax.text: Hotels now offer opt-in smart features. The room is smart only if you want it to be.

punchline.text: The smartest room knows when to listen and when to stay quiet.

quiz.question: What is the main guest concern about smart hotel rooms?
